_comment: WEEK 9 · MODULE 5 — RAW JSON-RPC MCP WIRE PROTOCOL EXCHANGE (Support Ops ticket-history-server)
model_call_location_statement: The model call (LLM inference) happens exclusively on the host/client agent side; the MCP server never executes an LLM call or knows about the model.

messages.direction: Client -> Server (Host Agent to MCP Server)

annotations.jsonrpc: Specifies the JSON-RPC standard version (must be strictly '2.0').
annotations.id: Unique integer or string identifier for this request; the server must echo back this exact ID in its response.
annotations.method: The MCP lifecycle RPC method name being invoked ('initialize').
annotations.params: Object containing the handshake parameters negotiation: requested protocol version, client capabilities (e.g. roots tracking, LLM sampling support), and client identity metadata.

messages.direction: Server -> Client (MCP Server to Host Agent)

annotations.jsonrpc: Confirms the JSON-RPC version ('2.0') used by the server.
annotations.id: Matches the client request ID (1), linking this response to the initial handshake request.
annotations.result: The server's capability declaration and metadata payload. Indicates tools capability is enabled ('tools': {'listChanged': true}) and reveals server name ('ticket-history-server') and implementation version ('4.0.11').

messages.direction: Client -> Server (Host Agent to MCP Server)

annotations.method: Lifecycle notification confirming the host agent has received the server's initialize response and is now ready for operational traffic.
annotations.params: Omitted because this notification carries no additional parameters.
annotations.id: Omitted because JSON-RPC notifications must not receive a response from the server.

messages.direction: Client -> Server (Host Agent to MCP Server)

annotations.id: Unique request sequence identifier (2) for tracking asynchronous replies.
annotations.method: Standard MCP tool discovery method ('tools/list') requesting all available tools exposed by this server.
annotations.params: Empty parameter object (can optionally include pagination cursor if supported).

messages.direction: Server -> Client (MCP Server to Host Agent)

tools.name: lookup_ticket_history
tools.description: Retrieve the escalation history, prior agent touches, and escalation level for a support ticket.

tools.name: get_ticket_details
tools.description: Retrieve ticket intake metadata, customer message summary, and reported channel.

annotations.result: Contains the list of discovered tools with their exact JSON Schema definitions (inputSchema). The host agent reads these schemas dynamically and translates them to Claude Anthropic function schemas without hardcoding.

messages.direction: Client -> Server (Host Agent to MCP Server)

annotations.method: Tool execution method ('tools/call') invoked by host agent after Claude decides to use the discovered tool.
annotations.params: Execution payload identifying the target tool ('lookup_ticket_history') and the arguments object passed by the model ('ticket_id': 'TCK-103').

annotations.result: The tool output envelope containing a 'content' array of MCP blocks. In this case, a text block with JSON payload detailing the complete escalation history, prior agent touches, and escalation status.
annotations.isError: Boolean flag indicating whether the tool invocation encountered an unhandled execution failure (false = successful execution).
